artworks.title: Santa Maria della Salute, Venice, at Sunset
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a city in the distance with a dome and towers silhouetted against the sky as seen from the water. The horizon aligns with the city's buildings, and the brushstrokes are delicate and watercolor-like. The colors are warm, dominated by pink, peach, and purple tones. The sky transitions in a gradient and reflects on the calm water. Some sailboats with faintly lit sails are close by, and more boats are visible further away near the cityscape. The scene conveys a serene atmosphere, illuminated by warm light.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Cardinal (Alessandro Peretti Montalto?)
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on greenish-brown laid paper (formerly blue)
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a man's head and shoulders. The man's head is turned slightly to the left in a partial profile view. He has a mustache and beard, with detailed facial features and prominent eyes looking straight ahead. The man wears a distinctive square-topped hat and a visible collar, possibly indicating a robe or cloak. The background is plain and monochromatic.

artworks.title: David and the Patriarchs with a Donor
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures engaged in discussion. The sketch features several figures, identifiable by their robes and crowns, depicted in an expressive manner. The figures are sketched with quick, fluid lines, suggesting a dynamic interaction among them. Some figures are seated, while others are standing, gesturing with raised hands or pointed fingers. The composition captures the essence of a discussion or council, with the use of ink on paper creating a sense of immediacy and movement.

artworks.title: Costume Studies
artworks.medium: black crayon on brown wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of clothing details and a torso. The artwork depicts studies of a coat sleeve and a partial torso. On the upper left, there are detailed sketches of coat sleeves showing folds and creases. The larger drawing on the right showcases a study of a coat, extending from the shoulder to the mid-thigh. The artist has signed the work as "J.F.M" in the lower center of the image.

artworks.title: Paulinus, Cardinal and Patriarch of Aquileia, Transfers His Seat to Grado
artworks.medium: pen and black, gray, and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures conversing near a coastal area. The scene includes individuals near a building with an arched portico and tall columns. In the background, there are ships with sails and two small figures near the waterfront. One child is pointing. The figures in the foreground wear elaborate robes, with some intricate detailing. The architecture, including arches and columns, adds grandeur and classicism to the scene.

artworks.title: Two Peasants Drinking
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 7.5 x 9.8 cm (2 15/16 x 3 7/8 in.), upper corners cut
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a simple setting. One is seated on a wooden chair with a cup in hand, and the other is standing beside them, leaning forward with a hand on the seated person's shoulder. Both figures wear headscarves and loose garments typical of the period. The seated figure's hair is covered, and their face is in a relaxed profile. The standing figure also wears a headscarf and has a gentle expression. The background is plain with subtle shading, emphasizing the interaction between the two figures.

artworks.title: A Partially Skinned Rat
artworks.artist: Italian 16th/17th Century, possibly Florentine or Roman
artworks.medium: two shades of red chalk with traces of black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a creature with an elongated body, thin limbs, and a long tail. The creature is shown in profile, displaying its spine and rib cage. The head of the creature resembles a skull, with large eye sockets and an elongated snout. The artwork is done in monochrome red tones, emphasizing the creature's skeletal structure and skin folds. The style emphasizes exaggerated features and textures, highlighting the creature's eerie appearance.

artworks.title: Aeneas in the Underworld
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray and gray-brown wash over graphite, with brown ink border line by the artist, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with mythical figures set against a dramatic background. There is a central female figure on a rocky formation surrounded by clouds and other ethereal figures. She wears a crown and flowing garments. Below her, two additional figures are depicted in dynamic poses; one is gesturing and the other stands beside them. The atmosphere is mystical and intense, with detailed linework and shading emphasizing movement and interaction between the figures. The style exudes qualities of dramatic narration and ancient mythological themes.

artworks.title: The Death of Lausus
artworks.medium: pen and black and gray ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an ancient battlefield scene with soldiers. The foreground shows soldiers wearing classic Greco-Roman armor and helmets. One soldier is limp or unconscious and being supported by two comrades, showing a moment of compassion or aid during a battle. In the background, other soldiers are engaged in battle with shields and weapons visible. The landscape includes rolling hills and clouds in the background. The drawing is detailed, capturing the expressions and textures of the scene.

artworks.title: Blessed Maria Vittoria Fornari's Vision of the Trinity
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite, with additions in black chalk, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious figure with multiple heads and a robed figure. The drawing features a seated figure with three heads and bearded faces holding a large orb adorned with a cross. The figure is dressed in flowing garments and surrounded by clouds, implying elevation. In the foreground, another robed figure kneels on the clouds, gazing upwards with hands crossed over the chest. Around both figures, smaller cloud-like forms with cherubic faces accentuate the heavenly theme. The drawing uses a monochromatic palette of sepia tones, emphasizing dynamic lines and the spiritual character of the scene.

artworks.title: Card Players
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor and gouache over black crayon, heightened with white gouache on card
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of people gathered around a table. The scene depicts several individuals, all wearing hats and engaged in what appears to be a lively conversation or game. One figure is holding cards, seemingly focused on the game, while others are gathered closely around. The artwork is in a warm color palette with shades of brown, ochre, and muted blue. The expressions and body language suggest a scene full of interaction and shared experience. This is in the style of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Two Studies for a Portrait of the Warren Family
artworks.medium: graphite with pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two scenes sketched side by side. The left side features a group with a seated and standing figures in a landscape, and the right side shows a more loosely drawn pair.

artworks.title: River God
artworks.medium: black chalk, heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This image displays a detailed drawing of a person's upper body in a dynamic posture. The figure is depicted in a seated or reclining position with one arm raised and bent at the elbow, and the other arm bent towards their chest. The head is not highly detailed, and the person has long flowing hair. They are partially covered by a fabric draped over their lower torso and lap. The person is not wearing any visible jewelry or holding any objects. The background is a simple, textured surface that directs focus to the figure. The name "Ribelles" is inscribed on the surface.

artworks.title: A Dog
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray-brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dog in a dynamic pose. The dog has its head turned upwards and back, as if reacting to a sound or an object above it. The dog is captured in a stance that suggests movement, with one of its front legs stepping forward and its other paws firmly planted. The body of the dog is detailed with pencil strokes emphasizing its fur texture. The background is plain, focusing attention on the dog.

artworks.title: The Christ Child Appearing to Saint Francis
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray-brown wash over red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: There is a sketch of a person kneeling on a cloud, with hands raised towards a small nude figure. The person has short, curly hair and visible facial features, dressed in loose-fitting robes. Cherubs and angelic figures surround them, with some having wings. The background shows clouds and additional cherubs.

artworks.title: The Marriage of Bacchus and Ariadne
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering of figures. The composition features various figures engaged in a scene. The figures are rendered in delicate and fluid graphite lines, suggesting movement and interaction. Some figures are seated and others are standing, with one figure reaching upwards with an extended arm. The background consists of clouds, creating an ethereal setting. The sketch captures a sense of dynamism and expression with its flowing lines.

artworks.title: A Seated Male Nude
artworks.medium: red chalk on brown laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing shows a full-body sketch of a male figure. He is seated, with one leg bent and resting on a ledge on the right and his other leg on the ground. His body is curved slightly inward, and his head is tilted downward as he looks to the right. The man has strong facial features with defined cheekbones, a prominent nose, and a full head of slightly wavy hair that falls back from his face. He is unclothed, revealing a well-defined, muscular physique. The man sits on what appears to be a draped cloth on top of undefined steps. The background is made of thin, diagonal lines. The drawing is done in red on tan paper.

artworks.title: A Seated Male Nude with His Hands Crossed over His Head
artworks.medium: black chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a nude male figure from the upper thighs upward. The man is reclining in a semi-seated position with his arms raised above his head. His facial features are depicted with strong lines, showcasing a pronounced brow and a concentrated expression. His hair is short and appears dark, complementing the textured shading used in the drawing. The figure does not wear any clothing or visible jewelry. The background is a textured surface, presumably the paper, which is a soft blue-gray tone, with no discernible setting or objects surrounding the figure.

artworks.title: Clouds over the Sea
artworks.medium: pastel on blue-gray wove paper

artworks.title: Half-Length Portrait of a Cleric
artworks.medium: graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait drawing of a person from the chest up. The individual is facing forward, looking directly at the viewer. The person has a round face with subtle expressions, short curly hair with indications of lightness or balding at the top, and is wearing formal dark clothing with a white clerical collar. No jewelry or objects are visible. The background is uniformly shaded.

artworks.title: A Seascape with Two Sail Boats
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite (in the sailboat at left) on beige laid paper
artworks.description: This painting shows a seascape with a tall sailboat visible on the left. The horizon is low in the image, creating a vast sky. In the distance on the right, there is a faint outline of another sailboat. The color scheme is soft, including shades of blue along and the beige of the underlying paper showing through. The sky has soft, rolling clouds, and the green-blue sea shows gentle waves. The brushstrokes in the painting are loose and visible.

artworks.title: A Sculpture of Saint Benedict in a Niche
artworks.medium: red chalk heightened with touches of white chalk on brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded man standing in a niche. He is dressed in robes with a hood, holding a staff in his right hand and an open book in his left hand. A small winged figure sits beside him, holding a shield. The background features an arched structure.

artworks.title: Two Male Figures: A Youth and an Old Man
artworks.medium: black and red chalk, with white heightening on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two people, depicted from the knees up. The person in the foreground is positioned slightly to the right, with their body leaning towards the left, creating a diagonal alignment. This person has a head of curly hair and their facial features are softly defined. They are wearing a light-colored tunic tied at the waist with a darker fabric. Draped over their shoulders is a flowing, reddish cloak. Behind this individual, another person is visible, positioned slightly behind with their face turned towards the left. This second figure appears to be older, with less hair. Both figures are elegantly posed, and they are intertwined in posture. The surrounding background is a plain, textured surface, and there are no visible objects or jewelry specified within the frame. The image has an unfinished quality.

artworks.title: A Roman Capriccio with the Pyramid of Gaius Cestius
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, with brown and gray-brown wash over black chalk counterproof on laid paper
artworks.description: A drawing of an ancient Roman structure with a fountain and sculptures. The image features a large, pyramid-like mausoleum structure in the background. In the foreground, there is a sculpted fountain with a reclining figure and a lion's head from where water flows. A dog interacts with the water, while two women talk beside the fountain. Additional sculptural elements can be seen on the structure, including a human figure relief. Natural elements like shrubs and stones are present in the scene.
